gloss: to choreograph; to create dance moves for

definitions.gloss: to choreograph; to create dance moves for
definitions.explanation: To design and assign dance movements or gestures for a performance.

examples.japanese: ダンスを{振|ふ}り{付|つ}ける。
{有名|ゆうめい}な{振付師|ふりつけし}がこの{曲|きょく}の{振|ふ}りを{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: A famous choreographer created the dance moves for this song.

examples.japanese: {学園祭|がくえんさい}のダンスの{振|ふ}り{付|つ}けを{考|かんが}えるのに3{週間|しゅうかん}かかった。
examples.english: It took three weeks to come up with the choreography for the school festival dance.

notes:
Composed of {振|ふ}り (movement, gesture) and {付|つ}ける (to attach). The noun form {振|ふ}り{付|つ}け (choreography) is very common and appears in various entertainment contexts from idol groups to musical theater. The person who choreographs is called a {振付師|ふりつけし} (choreographer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振|ふ}り{付|つ}けを{覚|おぼ}える: to learn the choreography
- {振|ふ}り{付|つ}けを{考|かんが}える: to think up choreography
- {振付師|ふりつけし}: choreographer
- {振|ふ}り{付|つ}けが{難|むずか}しい: the choreography is difficult

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {踊|おど}る: to dance — the general word for dancing itself, not choreographing
- {演出|えんしゅつ}する: to direct; to produce — broader term for stage/show direction that may include choreography
